summary: Kerb backing onto open parkland, 45 m from the nearest dorm, but on a busy road.
reasons: Cars park on opposite kerb, not this one
Junction island ahead; slope up to 7.7%

best_section.where: West end of the north kerb, before the junction island

drivers.seclusion: Grass verge and trees behind, a dormitory 45 m away; no homes close.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road, sealed shoulder beside the lane looks wide enough; a van fits before the island starts.
drivers.traffic: Junction on a collector road with a roundabout-style island; steady campus traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars line the south kerb; the north kerb has one car near the start, so use is unclear.

flags: Steep: about 3.6% over the best section, 7.7% max on the stretch
Junction and island at the east end
Noise from traffic at the junction
sun_shade: Trees shade the verge from the north; open to the sun otherwise.
